# ReadManiac

**Homepage:** [http://www.deep-shadows.com/hax/ReadManiac.htm](https://web.archive.org/web/20050203113608/http://www.deep-shadows.com/hax/ReadManiac.htm) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** Roman Lut

ReadManiac is a reader for large text files on Siemens and Nokia phones with
Java support. Text can be opened from the phone memory or downloaded over HTTP,
including in parts on devices with limited storage.

Features:

- Built-in small fonts for reading on a small screen;
- Install custom fonts and select the encoding;
- Search within text and search for books in the phone memory;
- Bookmarks and automatic page turning;
- Configure formatting, line spacing, the status line, and
  negative mode;
- Resume text download from the specified position.

Complete archives include builds for different languages and models,
documentation, font examples, and the CreateFont program for Windows.
